name: ADX-gated breakout continuation — ATR-scaled stop, trend-run exit (4h)
rationale: MECHANISM: same conditional-breakout economics (breaks only pay in a trend; ADX filters chop) but the risk overlay is an ATR-multiple stop rather than a fixed fraction, letting a volatile 4h breakout breathe without being noise-stopped, and the position is allowed to ride via a trailing stop armed after a profit cushion (asymmetric: tight-once-armed, open-ended upside — the trend-follower payoff). Entry: range_position near the ceiling AND adx above a fitted floor. DISCONFIRMER: kill if a FIXED-stop version of the same signal lives while this ATR/trailing version dies, or vice-versa with identical DSR — that would prove the edge is in the risk overlay, not the ADX-gated breakout thesis. Also kill if the adx gate adds no net lift over the ungated breakout (curve-fit gate).
catalyst: range-ceiling breakout in a trend, ridden with a volatility-scaled trailing stop
